uin: A parent inquires about mandatory vaccines for newborn infants in India within 6 weeks.

prompts.english: What mandatory vaccines should a newborn infant receive within the first 6 weeks under the National Immunization Schedule in India?
prompts.hindi: भारत में राष्ट्रीय टीकाकरण सारणी के तहत नवजात शिशु को पहले 6 सप्ताह के भीतर कौन से अनिवार्य टीके मिलने चाहिए?
prompts.code_switch: India me National Immunization Schedule ke under newborn baby ko pehle 6 weeks me kon-kon se mandatory vaccines milne chahiye?

critical_facts.text: BCG vaccine given at birth or within 1st week.
Hepatitis B birth dose given within 24 hours of birth.
OPV 0-dose at birth, and OPV-1 + Pentavalent-1 + Rotavirus-1 + fIPV-1 at 6 weeks.

important_facts.text: Vaccines available free of cost at government health centers.
Mother-child tracking card (MCP) issued for record keeping.

optional_facts.text: Official application forms available online and offline.

prohibited_claims: Claiming false upfront fees or unauthorized third-party middleman application processes.
